data.body:
Implementation pushed as Gerrit change 3027 (commit cb27a071c76), awaiting LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.

Four files: src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py (the RebarBoundaryDDGS client boundary), src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_T1.md (both rubric clauses), docs/adr/0063-web-search-capability-security-posture.md (the re-argument), tests/unit/test_web_tool_gating.py.

The seam is the DDGS client, not the Tool object. duckduckgo_search_tool(duckduckgo_client=RebarBoundaryDDGS(...)) keeps Tool.function as DuckDuckGoSearchTool.__call__, so tool.local.function.__self__ and .max_results survive and the existing gating tests still hold.

The boundary catches Exception, not just DDGSException. That distinction is the fix: a raw httpx error would otherwise still escape and still degrade the gate, so catching only DDGSException would not have fixed the reported bug. Branch 1 maps DDGSException('No results found.') to []; branch 2 maps everything else to a single WEB_SEARCH_UNAVAILABLE record.

Red/green evidence: 7 failed before (escaped DDGSException on both messages, escaped httpx.ConnectError, missing T1 and ADR clauses), 27 passed after. make verify: 20370 passed with exactly the 17 known macOS-arm64 pandoc 'Bad CPU type' failures and nothing else.

All 15 acceptance criteria verified with recorded per-AC evidence.
